name: Cydian
subtitle: A package manager with the iOS 6 look
description: Cydian's own source: the Cydian app for iPhones without a jailbreak.

apps.name: Cydian
apps.subtitle: Packages and apps with the iOS 6 look
apps.localizedDescription: Cydian lists apps from AltStore-style sources and, on a jailbroken iPhone, tweaks and themes from APT repos, with the iOS 6 look. The app signs apps on your iPhone with your own certificate (no server) and scrolls at 120Hz. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).

versions.localizedDescription:
Cydian updates itself in one step: it signs the update on the phone, the signing server holds it for a few minutes, and iOS asks Install right away.
Install at the top right installs straight away (Download IPA is on the page).
The test apps (Test Alpha, Test Beta...) are no longer mistaken for Cydian.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.3

The Installed tab is back in the app: your apps, and Cydian itself at its real version.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.2

Cydian shows itself in Installed at its real version, so its updates appear in Changes like any app.
Automatic appearance follows iOS, dark mode included (Light stays the default).
Featured opens Popular; the share sheet with Copy Link; the Reloading popup lasts as long as loading.
Fixes: the Add button's Paste state, the page shifting when typing in a popup.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.1

App pages: Install signs with your own certificate and installs; Download IPA keeps the file, on every older version too. No more hand-offs to AltStore, SideStore or Feather.
Installs in the app show only iOS's Install prompt.
Mark as Installed for apps installed another way.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.2.0

Installing in the app shows only iOS's Install prompt, no Open in iTunes before it.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.9

Mark as Installed on app pages: apps installed another way are followed for updates (Change Installed Version, Mark as Not Installed).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.8

Signing and installing end on a Done checkmark that fades, so it is clear the app was handed to iOS.
The Signing walkthrough moves to the next step by itself when you come back from Settings.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.7

The app opens on Home loading (title, the Loading spinner, the tab bar), like Cydia, instead of a black screen.
Installs in the app: the manifest request gets past the server proxy (0.1.5), and Cydian's built-in source names the newest version.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.6

Installs in the app work: the manifest request no longer trips the server proxy.
Install signs straight away; Signing walkthrough; built-in Cydian source and Essential Upgrade.
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/Cydian/releases/tag/v0.1.5
